title: Nigerian Financial System
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that have inadequate funds and therefore need borrowing to finance their operations."
The deficit economic entities are those that have inadequate funds and therefore need borrowing to finance their operations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that a financial instrument or asset can be converted into another asset class."
The convertibility feature means that a financial instrument or asset can be converted into another asset class.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a demand management issue, while structural programme focuses on supply management."
Stabilization programme is a demand management issue, while structural programme focuses on supply management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the introduction of structural reforms."
The major conditionality clause is the introduction of structural reforms.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most recent embodiment of financial advisors and portfolio management that have extensive computerised algorithmic portfolio allocations and trade implementations."
Robots (software) are the most recent embodiment of financial advisors and portfolio management that have extensive computerised algorithmic portfolio allocations and trade implementations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the authority in charge of policies that have an effect on a country's money supply and credit."
History of Central Bank A central bank is the authority in charge of policies that have an effect on a country's money supply and credit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a perfect place for firms or financial institutions to keep surplus funds until they are required."
The money market is a perfect place for firms or financial institutions to keep surplus funds until they are required.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a financial institution comprising 54 African and 26 non-African countries that promote economic and social progress in Africa through loans, equity investments, and technical assistance."

African Development Bank (ADB) is a financial institution comprising 54 African and 26 non-African countries that promote economic and social progress in Africa through loans, equity investments, and technical assistance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for ensuring financial stability as well as economic growth and development of the Nigerian economy."
The Central Bank of Nigeria is responsible for ensuring financial stability as well as economic growth and development of the Nigerian economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a kitty that mobilizes long term funds from Nigerian employees, banks, insurance companies as well as the Federal Government to advance loans at low interest rates to its contributors."

The National Housing Fund is a kitty that mobilizes long term funds from Nigerian employees, banks, insurance companies as well as the Federal Government to advance loans at low interest rates to its contributors.
